answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 150780 Country: Pakistan Title: I want to ask that wazifah is allow in Islam. Kindly provide any reference of Quran and Hadith. Question: I want to ask that wazifah is allow in Islam. Kindly provide any reference of Quran and Hadith. Answer ID: 150780 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 815/773/B=8/1438) Whether it is the verses of the Holy Quran or Hadith or lawful words you may recite them by asking any reliable and authentic scholar, it is allowed according to Shariah. It is not lawful to read any wazifah which contradicts the Holy Quran and Hadith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
